field_evidence.dataset_scope: INSPIRE Index Polygons contains locations of freehold registered property in England and Wales.
field_evidence.identifier_semantics: Each INSPIRE Index Polygon has a unique Land Registry-INSPIRE ID related to a registered title.
field_evidence.geometry_semantics: Polygons show the position and indicative extent of a registered property.
field_evidence.access_format: The guidance directs users to the Use land and property data service; files are published as GML.
field_evidence.canonical_extent_limitation: Definitive title extent is not established by the INSPIRE polygon itself; target-specific title-plan context is required before canonical parcel geometry can be asserted.

first_missing_criterion: Verified BUILDING_PRESENT canonical parcel geometry/bbox for this producer. HM Land Registry's official GOV.UK INSPIRE guidance confirms that INSPIRE polygons show only the position and indicative extent of registered property, that each polygon has a separate Land Registry-INSPIRE ID related to a registered title, and that the definitive title extent cannot be established from INSPIRE polygons alone. Local OpenCode must therefore retrieve and spatially bind a concrete target-relevant INSPIRE polygon/title-plan context before any canonical parcel bbox is asserted; after that, bind one exact official DEM/LIDAR tile or metadata-index record to the resulting bbox.
exact_blocker: The official HM Land Registry GOV.UK guidance is directly readable without login and materially changes the method from transport probing to authoritative semantics validation. It confirms that INSPIRE geometry is indicative rather than definitive title extent. Therefore an INSPIRE polygon cannot be promoted by this producer to canonical parcel geometry merely from dataset membership or metadata. No target-specific INSPIRE ID/title-plan binding is available in the verified lineage, and spatial join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
